scientific_integrity: Symbolic proof is supplied; exact finite computations independently check selected cases but cannot prove the universal claim. Closely related odd-order Peirce theorem and general Fourier/representation results are attributed to prior authors.
scientific_limitations: Finite abelian core quandles only, complex coefficients, right multiplication by nonzero idempotents. Does not enumerate all idempotents or handle arbitrary Alexander quandles or other characteristics; full-text access to two relevant 2026 abstracts was unavailable and historical priority may warrant expert review.
title: A sharp four-torsion bifurcation in Peirce spectra of finite abelian core quandles
